scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run watch -w @mmo/shared" "npm run dev -w @mmo/server" "npm run dev -w @mmo/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -b packages/server packages/client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mmo/server && npm run build -w @mmo/client
